title: June 2026
summary: The fairy found her wings — literally.

scenes.prose: Lilac hair with flowers worked into it, wings that actually read as translucent — the fairy stopped being a placeholder and started being her.

asset.alt: A four-petal blush blossom with a mint centre, marking the fairy's design arriving.

scenes.prose: The floating islands got their first real logic: each one a page, each page a place.

asset.alt: A sage-green leaf, marking the floating islands' logic connecting to the journal pages.
